description: Lists the other plugins on this site that offer abilities to agents (WooCommerce, FluentCRM and the like), each with how many abilities this connection can run now (`on`) and how many it cannot (`off`). Use it when a task needs something Agentimus’s own tools don’t do; then list-plugin-abilities opens one plugin. ⛔ Every ability starts off: only the site owner turns one on, in wp-admin. An empty or all-off answer means the owner has not allowed any yet.
name: agentimus-list-plugins

name.description: The plugin’s own name for its abilities, or its key.

off.description: Abilities that are off, or need a higher level than this site allows agents.

on.description: Abilities this connection can run now.

title: List plugins with abilities
